GetGatewayAuthDetail.summary: Retrieves the authentication details of a gateway.

schema.description: The authentication ID.
The ID of the gateway. You must configure this parameter or the GatewayUniqueId parameter.
The unique ID of the gateway. You must configure this parameter or the GatewayId parameter. This parameter takes precedence over the GatewayId parameter.

The language in which the returned results are displayed. Valid values:

- zh (default): Chinese.

- en: English.

schema.title: Schema of Response
schema.description: Schema of Response

Code.description: The response code. The status code 200 indicates that the request was successful.

Success.description: Indicates whether the request was successful.

GatewayUniqueId.description: The unique ID of the gateway for which authentication is enabled.

GatewayId.description: The ID of the gateway for which authentication is enabled.

Type.description:
The authentication method. Valid values:

- JWT

- OIDC

- IDaaS

- ExternalAuthZ (custom authentication service)

Issuer.description:
This parameter is valid if Type is set to JWT or OIDC:

- If Type is set to JWT, this parameter specifies the issuer of JWT claims.

- If Type is set to OIDC, this parameter specifies the issuer of OIDC claims.

Jwks.description: The JWT public key in JSON format.

IsWhite.description:
Indicates whether a whitelist is used. Valid values:

- true: A whitelist is used. Only requests with the hostnames and paths that you specify in the whitelist can access the cloud-native gateway without authentication.

- false: A blacklist is used. Only requests with the hostnames and paths that you specify in the blacklist require authentication.

GmtCreate.description: The time when the authentication was created. The time was formatted as a GMT timestamp.

GmtModified.description: The time when the authentication was modified. The time was formatted as a GMT timestamp.

TokenPosition.description:
The type of the JWT token:

- If this parameter is set to HEADER, the token is specified in the header.

TokenName.description: The position where the JWT token is stored.

TokenNamePrefix.description: The prefix of the JWT token.

TokenPass.description: Indicates whether the token is passed through.

RedirectUrl.description: The URL for redirection after authentication is successful. This parameter is valid if Type is set to OIDC or IDaaS. The redirect URL must be the same as the redirect URL that you configured in OIDC or IDaaS.

ClientId.description: The ID of the application in the service registration information. This parameter is valid if Type is set to OIDC or IDaaS.

ClientSecret.description: The application secret in the service registration information. This parameter is valid if Type is set to OIDC or IDaaS.

CookieDomain.description: The domain name of the cookie. After the authentication is successful, the cookie is sent to the specified domain name to maintain the logon status. This parameter is valid if Type is set to OIDC or IDaaS.

ScopesList.description: The OIDC scopes. The related parameter is valid if Type is set to OIDC.

LoginUrl.description: The URL that is used to log on to the IDaaS instance. This parameter is valid if Type is set to IDaaS.

Sub.description: The subject of JWT claims. This parameter is valid if Type is set to JWT.

ServiceId.description: The ID of the authentication service.

PrefixPath.description: The path of the authentication API.

TokenKey.description: The header in which the token is in the request message. Common header types include Authorization and Cookie.

items.description: The name of the allowed request header.
The name of the allowed response header.

Timeout.description: The timeout period of the authentication service. Unit: seconds.

IsRestrict.description:
Indicates whether the strict authentication mode is used. Valid values:

- true: The strict mode is used. If the authentication service is unavailable when a connection to the authentication service fails to be established or a 5xx error code is returned, the gateway rejects requests from the client.

- false: The loose mode is used. If the authentication service is unavailable when a connection to the authentication service fails to be established or a 5xx error code is returned, the gateway still accepts requests from the client.

Name.description: The name of the authentication service.

SourceType.description: The source of the authentication service.

GroupName.description: The group to which the authentication service belongs.

Namespace.description: The namespace to which the authentication service belongs.

WithRequestBody.description: Indicates whether bodies are carried in requests.

BodyMaxBytes.description: The maximum number of bytes in a body.

ResourceList.description: The authorization rules. The relationship among multiple rule conditions is OR, and the relationship among multiple match items in a rule condition is AND.

Id.description: The ID of the authentication rule.

AuthId.description: The ID of the authentication to which the rule belongs.

DomainId.description: The ID of the domain name in the rule.

DomainName.description: The domain name in the rule.

Path.description: The match path in the rule.

IsWhite.description:
Specifies whether to use a whitelist. Valid values:

- true: A whitelist is used. Only requests with the hostnames and paths that you specify in the whitelist can access the cloud-native gateway without authentication.

- false: A blacklist is used. Only requests with the hostnames and paths that you specify in the blacklist require authentication.

GatewayId.description: The ID of the gateway for which the authentication rule is configured.

GatewayUniqueId.description: The unique ID of the gateway for which the authentication rule is configured.

GmtCreate.description: The time when the authentication rule was created. The time was formatted as a GMT timestamp.

GmtModified.description: The time when the authentication rule was modified. The time was formatted as a GMT timestamp.

MatchType.description:
The method that is used to match requests based on paths. Valid values:

- EQUAL: exact match

- PRE: prefix match

- ERGULAR: regular expression match

IgnoreCase.description:
Indicates whether case sensitivity is enabled for request paths.

- true: Case sensitivity is enabled.

- false: Case sensitivity is disabled.

AuthResourceHeaderList.description: The request headers in the rule. The related parameters are valid when Type is set to ExternalAuthZ.

HeaderMethod.description:
Match condition:

- EQUAL

- NOT\_EQUAL

- EXIST

- NOT\_EXIST

- INCLUDE

- EXCLUDE

- PREFIX

- SUFFIX

- REGREX

HeaderValue.description: The value of the request header.

AuthResourceMode.description:
The authentication resource mode. Valid values:

- 0: simple mode

- 1: complex mode

AuthResourceConfig.description: YAML configuration in the complex mode.
AuthResourceConfig.example:
permissions:
  - not_rule:
      or_rules:
        rules:
        - and_rules:
            rules:
            - url_path:
                path:
                  ignore_case: false
                  prefix: /version
        - and_rules:
            rules:
            - url_path:
                path:
                  ignore_case: false
                  prefix: /header

GetGatewayConfig.summary: Retrieves the parameter configurations of a gateway.

schema.description: The unique ID of the gateway.
The language in which the returned results are displayed. Valid values: zh (default): Chinese. en: English

schema.title: RestResult<GatewayConfig>
schema.description: RestResult

Success.description:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

- `true`: The request was successful.

- `false`: The request failed.

Code.description: The status code. If the request was successful, a value of 200 is returned.

ErrorCode.description: The error code.

DynamicCode.description: This parameter is unavailable for use. Ignore this parameter.

DynamicMessage.description: This parameter is unavailable for use. Ignore this parameter.

GatewayUniqueId.description: The unique ID of the gateway.

EnableGenerateRequestId.description: Indicates whether request IDs are generated in request headers. Request IDs are used to trace requests. This parameter is used to determine the range of requests.

EnableGzip.description: Indicates whether GZIP compression is enabled. If GZIP compression is enabled, requests and responses are compressed. This reduces gateway traffic but increases the CPU load of the gateway. This parameter applies to requests and responses.

EnableSlashMerge.description: Indicates whether multiple forward slashes (/) in requests are combined into one forward slash (/). This parameter applies to requests. For example, if this parameter is set to true, www\.a.com//b is changed to www\.a.com/b based on the combination of forward slashes (/).

DownstreamIdleTime.description: The timeout period of the connection from the client to the gateway. If no requests are available in the specified period of time, the gateway connection is closed. This parameter applies to gateway connections.

PreserveHeaderFormat.description: Indicates whether all letters of a header are converted into lowercase letters. For requests and responses, HTTP/1.1 headers are not case-sensitive. By default, all letters of HTTP/1.1 headers are converted into lowercase letters to ensure the compatibility with HTTP/2 standards.

DownstreamConnectionBufferLimits.description: The maximum buffer size of a gateway connection. Unit: bytes. This parameter has an impact on the throughput and the use of gateway memory. This parameter applies to gateway connections.

EnableHardwareAccelerate.description: Indicates whether hardware acceleration is enabled. If hardware acceleration is not supported in the region where your cloud-native gateway resides or hardware acceleration is not enabled when you purchase your cloud-native gateway, this parameter does not take effect.

XffTrustedNum.description: The number of trusted proxies of the gateway. This parameter applies to requests and determines whether the gateway uses the request headers generated by the client. The request headers include x-forwarded-for and x-request-id.

EnableHttp2.description: Indicates whether HTTP/2 connections are used between the server and the client. This parameter applies to requests. The new configuration takes effect 1 to 2 minutes after you modify the configuration.

DownstreamHttp2MaxConcurrentStream.description: The maximum number of concurrent streams on an HTTP/2 connection. This parameter applies to requests.

InitialStreamWindowSize.description: The initial window size of a stream on an HTTP/2 connection between the gateway and the client. Unit: bytes. This parameter applies to requests.

InitialConnectionWindowSize.description: The initial window size of an HTTP/2 connection between the gateway and the client. Unit: bytes. This parameter applies to requests.

TraceOn.description: Indicates whether tracing analysis is enabled.

Sample.description: The sampling rate of tracing analysis. Unit: percentage (%).

GatewayUniqueId.description: The unique ID of the gateway.

GmtCreate.description: The time when the information about tracing analysis was created.

GmtModified.description: The time when the information about tracing analysis was modified.

TraceType.description:
The type of tracing analysis. Valid values:

- XTRACE: Managed Service for OpenTelemetry with the Zipkin protocol is used.

- SKYWALKING: Self-managed SkyWalking is used.

- OPENTELEMETRY: Managed Service for OpenTelemetry with the OpenTelemetry protocol is used.

- OTSKYWALKING: Managed Service for OpenTelemetry with the SkyWalking protocol is used.

ServiceId.description: The ID of the self-managed SkyWalking service.

ServicePort.description: The port number of the self-managed SkyWalking service.

LogOn.description: Indicates whether log shipping is enabled.

Id.description: This parameter is unavailable for use.

ProjectName.description: The name of the project for which log shipping is enabled.

LogStoreName.description:
The name of the Logstore to which logs are shipped.

- If the NginxCompatible parameter is set to false, the Logstore name is mse\_gw\_access\_log.

- If the NginxCompatible parameter is set to true, the Logstore name is nginx-ingress.

GatewayUniqueId.description: The unique ID of the gateway.

GmtCreate.description: This parameter is unavailable for use.

GmtModified.description: This parameter is unavailable for use.

NginxCompatible.description: Indicates whether Microservices Engine (MSE) Ingress gateways are compatible with NGINX Ingress gateways.

SupportWaf.description: Indicates whether Web Application Firewall (WAF) is supported for gateways.

EnableHttp3.description: Indicates whether the HTTP/3 protocol is supported.

UpstreamIdleTimeout.description: The default timeout period for a connection between a gateway and an upstream system. If the idle period of the connection to an upstream system exceeds the value of this parameter, the connection is closed.

ZipAlgorithm.description: The compression algorithm. Valid values: brotli and gzip. If you specify this parameter and you do not set EnableGzip to true, the value of EnableGzip is automatically changed to true.

PathWithEscapedSlashes.description:
The forwarding policy of the request whose Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) contains escaped characters, such as %2F, %2f, %5C, or %5c. Default value: KEEP\_UNCHANGED. We recommend that you use the default value.

Valid values:

- KEEP\_UNCHANGED

- REJECT\_REQUEST

- UNESCAPE\_AND\_REDIRECT

- UNESCAPE\_AND\_FORWARD

NoSupportedConfigList.description: The configurations that are not supported.

LogFilterConfig.description: This parameter is unavailable for use.

EnableProxyProtocol.description: Indicates whether the proxy protocol is enabled. If a Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance is used as a traffic ingress, the real IP address of the client cannot be obtained if you do not enable the proxy protocol. After you enable the proxy protocol, requests that do not comply with the proxy protocol remain unaffected.

EnableCustomAuthConfigPush.description: Indicates whether the connection is closed if custom authentication rules change. The value true indicates that the connection is not closed. This parameter is suitable for scenarios in which custom authentication services are available and WebSocket and online business are used.

KeepaliveHeaderTimeout.description: The connection timeout period contained in the keep-alive response header that is returned to the client. For example, if you set this parameter to 10, the response header `keep-alive: timeout=10` is returned. If you set this parameter to 0, the response header is not returned.

WebsocketTermGracePeriod.description: The keep-alive time that is maintained for the WebSocket connection in scenarios where the connection needs to be closed, such as gateway upgrade or restart. Unit: seconds.

- `true`: supported

- `false`: not supported

- `true`: enabled

- `true`: The cluster is restarted.

- `false`: disabled

- `true`: supported

- `false`: not supported

- `true`: enabled

- `false`: disabled

- `true`: supported
